messages:
Alex Kim: Heads-up — planning the staged traffic shift for model-serving v2.4 today. Target start 14:00 PT. Can people confirm availability for smoke/rollback?
Maria Chen: I can be around for the 14:00 slot, I'll own the smoke checks. Will run the standard `smoke-check` job. :white_check_mark:
Devon Singh: I'll trigger the rollout and monitor infra metrics. ETA to kick off is +5m from agreed time to let preflight finish.
Samir Patel: Which cohorts are we using for the initial 1%? Prefer to pick low-traffic geos: APAC-eu fallback?
Alex Kim: Plan is: 1% global -> 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100%. Initial 1% to be limited to internal beta users + APAC small slices (apac-1, apac-2). Avoid eu-large and financial customers.
Jessie (oncall): Oncall will watch error budget and latency SLOs for first 30m of each step. I need the smoke script and alert thresholds.
Maria Chen: Smoke script (run after deploy step):
```bash
# quick health + sample generation
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-v2","input":"smoke test"}' | jq '.status'
```
Alert thresholds: p95 latency > 700ms OR error rate > 0.8% -> immediate rollback. Also watch token-cost spike > 2x baseline.
Devon Singh: Noted. I'll wire perf-bot to post key signals to this thread. Also will create a pinned checklist in the release doc.
perf-bot: Posting dashboard links: latency -> https://metrics.redwood/d/latency, errors -> https://metrics.redwood/d/errors, qps -> https://metrics.redwood/d/qps
Alex Kim: Rollback plan: tag `redwood-v2.4` has a `rollback` playbook — if we see alerts in two consecutive 5-min windows post-step, we stop ramp and revert to `redwood-v2.3` in the same window. Devon/Jessie to confirm rollback owner.
Devon Singh: I'll be rollback owner during the rollout. I'll prepare a quick `kubectl rollout undo` snippet and keep the CIDR for traffic-weights handy.
Samir Patel: Cohort selection: added apac-1/apac-2 + internal-beta label to canary set. Excluding customers with SLA=enterprise and payment=true. I pushed cohort mapping to the release branch.
Maria Chen: I'll run the smoke checks at +2m and +10m after each ramp step. If smoke fails, I'll post `SMOKE FAIL` here with logs.
Jessie (oncall): For pager escalation: if error rate > 2% or p99 > 1.5s, page SRE primary. Everything else we coordinate in-thread.
Alex Kim: Small coordination items: 1) Keep canary step windows at least 15 minutes. 2) No other infra changes within the window. 3) Post `OK STEP` when clear.
Devon Singh: Kicking off preflight now (lint, infra health, rollout gating). Will update in 5.
Maria Chen: preflight green. Ready. :rocket:
deploy-bot: deploy pipeline `release/v2.4` started (build 2026-03-17.1)
Devon Singh: Starting 1% -> triggering routing change to canary cohort. Maria please run smoke in ~2m.
Maria Chen: running smoke now...
Maria Chen: smoke passed (sample generation ok, p95 340ms, errors 0.02%). OK STEP.
Alex Kim: Proceed to 5% in 20m. Devon to execute at +20m, Maria to run post-step smoke.
Samir Patel: Noted. I've started synthetic probes against canary endpoints, will report if divergence > 10%.
perf-bot: Canary 1% metrics baseline: p95 360ms, errors 0.03%, qps ~120
Devon Singh: If anything looks off before 20m we'll abort early. Otherwise planning gradual ramps as scheduled.
Jessie (oncall): I'm on the line. Pager rules set.
Alex Kim: Thanks team — post any anomalies here. If all green at 50% we can schedule final cutover in 2 hours. :thumbsup:
